{{Top|leg}}
A '''Model 88 electric shield''' was a type of [[energy dispersion system]], a device designed to distribute energy across armor and ground it, which protected against electricity and stun weapons. It was produced by [[Atlas Corp]].<ref name="FDCR">''[[Star Wars: Force and Destiny Core Rulebook]]''</ref>
